answer: The assay asks where your hands were, not who you are. Thirty mesas open each epoch for one twenty-minute window: a claimant assays a copper sample, seeded by the last block and the key, no sample repeats. Entry locks 90 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root; ten linked fakes lock 2,475 POA. Each assay needs three stranger witnesses, two mesas each. One operator assays two at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten assays, thirty witnesses at once. A missed assay burns 20; one sample at two mesas burns both bonds. Times match funding roots, so a haven on one pair of hands holds one claim.
